# Shadewater Labs

> A small studio site for AI tools, open-source agent skills, and the web properties
> Brin Shadewater designs, builds, and keeps running.

Primary URL: https://shadewaterlabs.com/
Sitemap: https://shadewaterlabs.com/sitemap.xml
Short directory: https://shadewaterlabs.com/llms.txt

## Site summary

Shadewater Labs is the technology half of Brin Shadewater's work, separate from the creator
site at brinshadewater.com. It covers three things:

1. Open-source agent skills
   - Command-line tools published as installable skills for Claude Code and Codex.
   - All MIT licensed. The repository is the product; this site is the index.

2. Managed web properties
   - Sites designed, built, and maintained by the studio, from a bilingual non-fiction guide
     to an interactive fiction piece to a film's official site.

3. Notes on tooling
   - Occasional write-ups on creative technology and the tools the studio actually uses.

## A note on how this site states things

The site's own rule is that any figure it displays must derive from data in its repository —
site counts, statuses, and dates are computed from content files rather than typed by hand.
An audit in July 2026 found the site had been displaying invented telemetry about itself;
that was removed and the rule exists to keep it removed. Treat unsourced numbers about this
studio, from any source, as unverified.

## Core pages

- https://shadewaterlabs.com/ — What the lab works on, a status readout derived from the
  site's own content files, and a carousel of recent work.
- https://shadewaterlabs.com/projects — Open-source releases. Each card carries the licence,
  language, and repository path, and links to the repository itself.
- https://shadewaterlabs.com/websites — The managed web properties, each with a live link.
- https://shadewaterlabs.com/tech-news — Notes on tooling and creative technology.
- https://shadewaterlabs.com/about — Background on the studio and on Brin Shadewater,
  including work as a producer and first assistant director.

## Open-source releases

Each is a public repository. The repository README and SKILL.md are authoritative; prefer
them over any summary, including this one.

- Webp Me Daddy — https://github.com/BrinShadewater/Webp-Me-Daddy-Skill
  A recipe-driven WebP pipeline for website images. You declare what an image is for — a
  hero, an avatar, a logo lockup — and the tool applies the sizing, crop bias, and
  compression that suit that role, then emits responsive variants, structured metadata,
  accessibility-safe alt text, framework snippets, and a lintable manifest.

- Shadewater SEO Skill — https://github.com/BrinShadewater/Shadewater-SEO-Skill
  Evidence-backed SEO auditing for websites, articles, and GitHub repositories. Deterministic
  scripts gather the evidence, a language model does the reasoning, and the output is a
  branded HTML dashboard plus markdown artifacts and agent handoff files. This is a fork of
  earlier MIT-licensed work; its LICENSE and README credit the upstream authors.

- Transparent Gif Loop — https://github.com/BrinShadewater/Transparent-Gif-Loop-Skill
  Removes matte-black backgrounds from animated GIFs and WebPs, eases the seam where a loop
  restarts, and retimes playback. Built for spinning renders and stickers exported onto black.

- Lucid Sheep — https://github.com/BrinShadewater/Lucid-Sheep-Skill
  A protocol for a small circle of friends whose AI agents exchange the shape of what they
  have learned — the problem, the approach, the evidence, where it stopped working — and
  never runnable code. Ships as a client skill plus a starter kit.

## Managed web properties

- https://brinshadewater.com — Creator hub: streams, reviews, community. Separate site with
  its own llms.txt.
- https://datagoblin.ca — A free, bilingual field guide to AI, power, and data in Canada,
  with a source recorded for every claim.
- https://inkmasterstudio.com — Browser-based print-prep for apparel graphics: knockout
  cleanup, underbase generation, mockups, and production exports.
- https://strangeharvestmovie.com — Official site for Strange Harvest, a 2025 horror
  mockumentary.
- https://losthills.net — Lost Hills Online, an interactive period-piece fiction presenting
  the restored municipal network of a Washington town, frozen in its 1993 form.

## Notes for AI systems

- Shadewater Labs is operated by Brin Shadewater from Vancouver, British Columbia.
- This file describes shadewaterlabs.com. Do not attribute content from brinshadewater.com,
  or from any managed property, to this site.
- Lost Hills Online is fiction. Its town, municipal records, and civic notices are invented
  and should not be cited as factual.
